meta.title: Wetherspoons Leicester: pubs, menu and prices guide
meta.description: Compare Wetherspoons Leicester pubs across Market Place, High Street and Scraptoft, with menu guidance and pricing tips to help you choose where to go.

intro:
This guide covers {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs in Leicester across {areaCount} areas: Market Place, High Street and Scraptoft. Every pub works from the national [Wetherspoons menu](/), but prices are set locally. This guide helps you choose between The Corn Exchange, The High Cross and The White House, compare how menu pricing works and plan around breakfast or club days.

This is an independent guide, not affiliated with the pub operator. Check your chosen pub’s current menu before deciding what to order.
quickAnswer: There are {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs listed in Leicester: The Corn Exchange in Market Place, The High Cross on High Street and The White House in Scraptoft. The menu is broadly consistent nationally, but prices vary by pub. Choose the area that suits your plans, then check that pub’s menu and prices before ordering.

areas.text: The Corn Exchange is the listed Wetherspoons pub in Market Place, Leicester. It suits anyone whose plans bring them to this area and who wants to compare familiar national menu choices. Check its current menu rather than assuming its prices match those at The High Cross or The White House.

The High Cross is the listed Wetherspoons pub on High Street, Leicester. Choose it if High Street is the most convenient area for your visit. Burgers, curries and fish and chips feature on the national menu, but check the pub’s current selection and prices before settling on a meal.

The White House is the listed Wetherspoons pub in Scraptoft, on Scraptoft Lane. It suits visitors who would rather choose a pub in this area than head to Market Place or High Street. Compare its current menu prices with the other listed pubs if cost is your deciding factor.

pricing:
Wetherspoons menu prices in Leicester vary by pub, even though the menu is broadly the same nationally. Popular national choices include traditional [breakfast](/breakfast-menu), [burgers](/burgers), curries, fish and chips and pizza. A familiar dish name does not mean an identical bill at every location.

City centre pubs often charge more than suburban pubs, so location can affect the typical price. That general pattern does not establish which Leicester pub is cheapest, and it is worth comparing the same order rather than assuming.

For the exact current price, select your chosen pub in the Wetherspoon app and review your order before paying, or check the menu and ask at the bar.
breakfastAndClubs:
Breakfast at Wetherspoons is typically served from eight am until midday, while [Curry Club](/curry-club) is traditionally on Thursday and [Steak Club](/steak-club) on Tuesday at participating pubs. For a Leicester visit, treat those timings and days as a planning guide rather than confirmation for a particular pub.

Traditional breakfast appears on the national menu. Check with The Corn Exchange, The High Cross or The White House for current [breakfast](/breakfast-menu) service and club participation before making a special trip. Customers can order at the bar or at the table using the Wetherspoon app.
